nina: Quick thought run a tiny "Gratitude Vending" pop-up for next Friday. Employees can drop a one-line shoutout into a bowl and pick a wrapped snack + a pre-printed spot card. Low admin. Need budget ok and a volunteer for set-up.

omar: Love it. Ballpark budget?

nina: $80 snacks, $25 print cards, $20 small wrapping = $125.

kelly: Are spot cards taxable? We should log recipients.

omar: For under $250 it's fine as swag; still log name + manager + reason.

kelly: I'll volunteer for 10:3011:30 shift.

ops-bot: Created calendar event "Gratitude Vending Pop-up" Fri 10:0013:00.

omar: Can hospitality supply individually wrapped snacks? If yes, we cut cost.

nina: I'll confirm and handle prints. Nina -> confirm hospitality, Kelly -> volunteer, Omar -> budget approval. I'll post final blurb for comms tomorrow.

omar: Approved. Keep receipts.

nina: Thanks all closing here once comms live.
